(C) 12pm to 4pm
(D) 5am to 10am

- **Between 5am and 10am**: William was not seen by Thomas.
- **Between 12pm and 4pm**: William was not seen by Lisa.
- **Between 4pm and 7pm**: William was not seen by Mary.

The only time period that fits all these conditions is between 10am and 12pm. During this time, William was not seen by anyone else, and the orchestra hall was closed after 7pm.
